body:
This adds two explicit local Hamiltonian/instrument constructions on qubit sites in which permanent marker observables coexist with prepared coherent matter. The [complete note](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/30fddd97f8909d791d4e116c4635b25122487862/docs/NATIVE_PERMANENT_MARKERS_COHERENT_MEDIA_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-09-30.md) proves both constructions and their resource bounds:

- Fixed record corridors have a paid saturation cost and an all-time negative-grand-energy bound. Their active matter cells are disconnected and the corridor mask is supplied.
- A spatially covariant isolated-motif law has permanent markers, positive mean marker density and negative grand energy on an explicit volume-independent finite interval. The coherent initial preparation is essential: blank input preserves N−M and has a nonnegative grand-energy floor.

Status is **bounded_theorem / conditional-support**, with frontier-discovery trace. The actual landed native H0 note is the sole mathematical theorem premise. No open EOS, threshold or response proposal is assumed. The changed laws, basis, GKSL/Born instrument, clock, preparation and marker interpretation are supplied. This does not derive physical Record/Admissibility realization, an autonomous source, a phase, sound, gravity or law selection; no axiom or primitive is added.

Validation and review:

- The [canonical primary](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/30fddd97f8909d791d4e116c4635b25122487862/scripts/native_permanent_markers_coherent_media_2026_09_30.py) produced [seven passing exact finite groups](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/30fddd97f8909d791d4e116c4635b25122487862/logs/runner-cache/native_permanent_markers_coherent_media_2026_09_30.txt). Eight actual single-change mutants failed by their intended assertions, with no resource kills. [Execution evidence](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/30fddd97f8909d791d4e116c4635b25122487862/.claude/science/physics-loops/native-record-medium-20260930/ACTUAL_EXECUTION_RESULTS.md) and [control derivations](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/30fddd97f8909d791d4e116c4635b25122487862/.claude/science/physics-loops/native-record-medium-20260930/CONTROL_DERIVATION.md) delimit what those fixtures test; the general dynamical statements are proved analytically.
- One fresh independent Astra-low reviewer read the complete final argument, primary and actual transitive premises, independently reconstructed both constructions, and confirmed all 150 paths at head `30fddd97`. [Source report](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/6adb6afa72df1dbfcc494656530e5e237b322b19/.claude/science/physics-loops/toe-gravity-law-24h-20260929/native-record-medium-independent-review/REPORT.md), [independent reconstruction](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/6adb6afa72df1dbfcc494656530e5e237b322b19/.claude/science/physics-loops/toe-gravity-law-24h-20260929/native-record-medium-independent-review/INDEPENDENT_RECONSTRUCTION.md), and [complete dispositions](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/6adb6afa72df1dbfcc494656530e5e237b322b19/.claude/science/physics-loops/toe-gravity-law-24h-20260929/native-record-medium-independent-review/SOURCE_DISPOSITIONS.json): PASS WITH BOUNDED CLAIMS, no material findings or requested source changes. This is a source verdict, not audit or retained status.
- The [actual final schema2/cache check](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/6adb6afa72df1dbfcc494656530e5e237b322b19/.claude/science/physics-loops/toe-gravity-law-24h-20260929/native-record-medium-delivery-final/ROOT_FINAL_RESULT.json) passed at the identical committed tree: 358.523 wall seconds, 373.027 measured CPU seconds including monitoring. No scientific rerun was needed. [Exact record](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/6adb6afa72df1dbfcc494656530e5e237b322b19/.claude/science/physics-loops/toe-gravity-law-24h-20260929/native-record-medium-delivery-final/UNIT_V2_FINAL_HEAD.json).
- The generated manifest acknowledges exactly one new node and two intended edges, preserving all 6,814 prior entries. [Topology](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/30fddd97f8909d791d4e116c4635b25122487862/.claude/science/physics-loops/native-record-medium-20260930/graph/TOPOLOGY_CHECK.json), [12-section conformance](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/30fddd97f8909d791d4e116c4635b25122487862/.claude/science/physics-loops/native-record-medium-20260930/FINAL_CONFORMANCE.md), and [after-output cluster evaluation](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/6adb6afa72df1dbfcc494656530e5e237b322b19/.claude/science/physics-loops/toe-gravity-law-24h-20260929/native-record-medium-milestone-cold-read/ROOT_CLUSTER_EVALUATION.md).

Run the finite controls with `python3 scripts/native_permanent_markers_coherent_media_2026_09_30.py`. The historical rational-coupling builder limitation and its corrected discriminating control are preserved, as are all original proof/check artifacts.

[Author handoff](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/30fddd97f8909d791d4e116c4635b25122487862/.claude/science/physics-loops/native-record-medium-20260930/HANDOFF.md) records the dated preparation state; the review and final validation linked above occurred subsequently. [Trace gate](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/30fddd97f8909d791d4e116c4635b25122487862/.claude/science/physics-loops/native-record-medium-20260930/TRACE_GATE.md) and [imports](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/30fddd97f8909d791d4e116c4635b25122487862/.claude/science/physics-loops/native-record-medium-20260930/ASSUMPTIONS_AND_IMPORTS.md) retain the physical-selection obligations. Full current-main integration checks, independent audit and any future landing remain separate and unrun in this campaign. No merge or authority-status change is requested or performed by this delivery.
